sample.rationale: Both entries locate agency in exactly one small, fully-controlled domain (own HEAD / own will), and both name the rest of the system — the shared trunk / external circumstance — as something you meet deliberately rather than command; the tool entry uses the philosopher's own coined word.

sample.label: same-form-different-rate
sample.rationale: Both entries independently describe one underlying form whose identity is entirely a function of the rate/context at which it is read — envelope-vs-oscillator and projection-vs-projection are the same structural move in different material.
sample.evidence: The same curve, slowed down, is a sound's loudness contour; sped up, it is the sound itself. / a person who exists in many states at once... can only be met as one of them at a time.

sample.rationale: Both entries separate a load-bearing substance (geometry actually bound to real state / an authentically lived practice) from a seductive-but-secondary surface polish (camera, lighting / production value, optimized thumbnails), and both name the same failure mode: pursuing the surface before the substance produces something dishonest about what it actually is.
sample.evidence: Knows that the seductive part of 3D — orbiting cameras, dramatic lighting — is rarely where the meaning is, and that the meaning usually lives in *what the geometry is bound to*... The seductive steps (4) come late on purpose — a scene that's beautiful before its geometry is bound to the right state is a scene that's lying about what it shows. || Their quality markers: High production value (expensive camera, perfect lighting, polished edit)... Outcome: Burnout, emptiness even if it works. You arrive depleted, not peaceful. / Your quality markers: Authentic integration... Outcome: Sustainable, meaningful, feels good.
